title: Always, Continually, In Everything
question: How do rejoicing, prayer, and thanks belong together?
blurb: Three short commands in a row. Four verses that show what they look like lived out.

nodes.content: How do rejoicing, prayer, and thanks belong together?

nodes.verseText: Rejoice at all times. Pray without ceasing. Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,
Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
